source_text: De coelo descendet civitas in anastasi prima: Est quod referamus de fabrica tanta coelesti. Resurgemus illi qui fuimus illi devoti, Et incorrupti erunt, jam tunc sine morte viventes: Sed nec dolor ullus, nec gemitus erit in illa. Venturi sunt illi quoque sub Antichristo qui vincunt Robusta martyria: et ipsi toto tempore vivunt, Recipiuntque bona quoniam mala passi fuere, Et generant ipsi per annos mille nubentes. Comparantur ibi tota vectigalia terrae, Terra quia nimium fundit sine fine novata. Inibi non pluvia, non frigus in aurea castra, Obsidiae nullae, sicut nunc, neque rapinae, Nec lucernae lumen desiderat civitas illa: Ex auctore suo lucet, nec non ibi paret Per duodecim millia stadia lata; longa, sic alta; Radicem in terra, sed caput cum coelo peraequat, In urbe pro foribus autem sol et luna lucebit. Malus in angore septus propter justos alendos. Ab annis autem mille Deus omnia perdet.
pass_a_gloss: From heaven the city will descend in the first resurrection: There is what we must report about such a great heavenly structure. We who were devoted will rise again, and they will be incorrupt, already then living without death: But neither will any pain, nor any groan be in that place. Those also who will come under the Antichrist, who overcome strong martyrdoms, will live for the whole time, and they will receive good things because they suffered evil, and they themselves will produce offspring for a thousand years, marrying. All the revenues of the earth are compared there, because the earth, renewed without end, produces exceedingly. There is no rain, no cold in the golden camp, no sieges, as now, nor plunderings, nor does the city desire the light of lamps: It shines from its author, and indeed there it is equal, for twelve thousand stadia wide; long, thus high; having its root on the earth, but its head equal with heaven; in the city, instead of doors, the sun and the moon will shine. The evil one is confined in anguish for the sake of nourishing the just. But from a thousand years, God will destroy all things.
